verdict.rationale: Unleash documents change requests that require an extra approval step before any changes can be made in an environment, such as production. Changes can also be grouped and applied at a specific time. The GitHub README lists change requests among the hosted/enterprise features, which suggests a paid-tier dependency. Missing for 10: detail on approver configuration (number of approvers, who may approve), clarity on plan/tier availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
features such as role-based access control, change requests, single sign-on, and SCIM
